entries.name: addGuide
entries.sig: addGuide( compId: string, isVertical: boolean, position: number, ): number

entries.name: primitive
entries.note: Same selection trap as api.create. Types: rectangle, ellipse, polygon, star, ring, ... Use cav.rect()/cav.ellipse().

entries.name: create
entries.sig: create( layerType: string, name?: string, allowDefaultPreset?: boolean, ): string
entries.note: Places the new layer next to the current selection (it can end up inside a hidden group). Call api.select([]) before and after, or use cav.create().

entries.name: resetLayerAttributes
entries.sig: resetLayerAttributes( layerId: string, includeTransformAttributes?: boolean, ): void

entries.name: parent
entries.note: Keeps the child's world transform, so the child gets compensating position/scale. Set position, scale and rotation again after parenting (cav.create does this).

entries.name: setStroke
entries.note: Call api.setStroke(layer, true) before setting stroke.* attributes. Stroke width scales with the layer's scale.

entries.name: getBoundingBox
entries.sig: getBoundingBox( layerId: string, worldSpace: boolean, ): { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; centre: { x: number; y: number }; left: number; right: number; top: number; bottom: number; }
entries.note: getBoundingBox(layer, worldSpace) -> {x,y,width,height,centre,left,right,top,bottom}. Y points up; the comp centre is (0,0).

entries.name: getSelectionBoundingBox
entries.sig: getSelectionBoundingBox(worldSpace: boolean): { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; centre: { x: number; y: number }; left: number; right: number; top: number; bottom: number; }

entries.name: setInFrame
entries.note: A group's in/out frames hide all its children: a clean way to cut between scenes.

entries.name: reorder
entries.note: api.reorder(a, b) puts a BELOW b in the layer stack.

entries.name: compareVersions
entries.sig: compareVersions( firstVersion: string, secondVersion: string, ): boolean

entries.name: set
entries.note: api.set(layer, {attr: value}). Vector attributes take [x, y]. Colours take '#rrggbb'. Comp: resolution, fps, startFrame, endFrame, backgroundColor, motionBlur.

entries.name: setGenerator

entries.name: connect
entries.sig: connect( fromId: string, fromAttrId: string, toId: string, toAttrId: string, force?: boolean, ): void
entries.note: api.connect(fromLayer, fromAttr, toLayer, toAttr). Masks: connect(shape,'id',target,'masks'). Filters: connect(filter,'id',shape,'filters'). Deformers: connect(behaviour,'id',shape,'deformers').

entries.name: disconnect
entries.sig: disconnect( fromId: string, fromAttrId: string, toId: string, toAttrId: string, ): void

entries.name: keyframe
entries.sig: keyframe( layerId: string, frame: number, dictionary: unknown, ): string
entries.note: api.keyframe(layer, frame, {attr: value}). Hex strings on colour attributes are silently ignored: key .r/.g/.b separately (cav.key does this). String keys on text are ignored.

entries.name: deleteKeyframe
entries.sig: deleteKeyframe(layerId: string, attrId: string, frame: number): void

entries.name: magicEasing
entries.sig: magicEasing( layerId: string, attrId: string, frame: number, easingName: string, expression?: string, ): void
entries.note: Eases the segment that STARTS at this key. 'Custom' takes an expression in x (0..1), for example '1 - pow(1-x,3)'. Without easing, keys are linear.

entries.name: getKeyframeTimes
entries.note: Returns an array of frame numbers (the types file says void; Cavalry 2.7.2 returns int[]).

entries.note: Blocking. Render queue items have filePath, fileName, frameRange [start,end], resolutionScale. `cav render` wraps this and muxes audio with ffmpeg.

entries.note: Renders the current frame (set it with api.setFrame first). '.png' is appended to the path. Soloing a nested layer renders blank unless its top-level parent is soloed.
